"""Main's bounded real VMM qualification after source checks; no model inference."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_vmm_tiny_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
qualification_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-tiny-qualification-root-v3/record.json'
qualification = json.loads(qualification_path.read_text())
assert qualification['passed'] and qualification['complete'] and not qualification['active']
prior_pin = next(row for row in qualification['originals'] if row['path'].endswith('/main-native-copy-queue-tiny-root-v3/record.json'))
assert m.sha(prior_pin['path']) == prior_pin['sha256']
old = json.loads(Path(prior_pin['path']).read_text())
assert old['passed'] and old['complete'] and not old['active']
ENV = dict(old['environment'], STRATA_COPY_ENGINE='0', ZE_ENABLE_VALIDATION_LAYER='1', ZE_ENABLE_PARAMETER_VALIDATION='1')
MODULE = re.compile(r'/(?:libsycl|libur_|libumf|libze_)[^/]*$')
EXPECTED = set(qualification['expected_provider_libraries'])
assert EXPECTED == set(old['expected_provider_libraries'])
assert len(EXPECTED) == 8
assert all(m.sha(path) == digest for path, digest in qualification['expected_library_hashes'].items())
health_command = next(c for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'health-before')
FAULT = re.compile(old['kernel_checks']['kernel-before']['filter'], re.I)


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    build_path = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-root-v2/record.json'
    lint_path = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v3/record.json'
    build, lint = [json.loads(path.read_text()) for path in (build_path, lint_path)]
    assert all(data['passed'] and data['complete'] and not data['active'] for data in (build, lint))
    assert lint['lints_qualified']
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in build['commands'])
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in lint['source_pins'].items())
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-small-upload-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=ENV, source_pins=lint['source_pins'], source_revision=None,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, adopted=False, reset_executed=False, service_changes=False,
             qualification_receipts={str(path): m.sha(path) for path in (build_path, lint_path, qualification_path, Path(prior_pin['path']))},
             boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
             provider_hashes={path: m.sha(path) for path in sorted(EXPECTED)},
             raw_log_budget_bytes=32 << 20, case_log_budget_bytes=4 << 20,
             scope='Actual owned HostUSM single bulk copy for seven aligned representative widths/all512 distinguishable expert canaries; 1MiB reserved device backing, exact private offsets and unchanged physical accounting, explicit declined-layout per-expert fallback; not model/max1.36GB/phase-VMM/speed qualification')

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def observe(label):
        def interaction(io, entry):
            io.proc.stdin.close()
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
            libraries = set()
            reads = 0
            while not io.exit_watch.poll(0) or not io.eof:
                io.poll()
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'finite tiny deadline'
                io.read()
                io.pending.clear()
                if not io.exit_watch.poll(0) and reads < 256:
                    identity = m.identity(entry['pid'])
                    if identity:
                        assert identity['start_ticks'] == entry['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
                        assert identity['sid'] == entry['pid']
                        try:
                            maps = Path(f"/proc/{entry['pid']}/maps").read_text()
                            assert len(maps.encode()) <= 1 << 20
                            libraries.update(line.split()[-1] for line in maps.splitlines()
                                             if line.split() and MODULE.search(line.split()[-1]))
                        except FileNotFoundError:
                            pass
                        reads += 1
                time.sleep(0.02)
            r.setdefault('actual_library_maps', {})[label] = dict(paths=sorted(libraries), bounded_reads=reads)
            save()
        return interaction

    def run(label, argv, gpu=False, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED TINY CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        if gpu:
            r['gpu_executed'] = True
            save()
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, interaction=observe(label) if gpu else None,
                            wall=60, cpu=120, rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return stdout, stderr, c

    def kernel(label):
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '--after-cursor', r['kernel_cursor'], '--no-pager', '-o', 'json'])
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        faults = [row for row in rows if FAULT.search(str(row.get('MESSAGE', '')))]
        dump_present = Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:05:00.0/devcoredump/data').exists()
        r.setdefault('kernel_checks', {})[label] = dict(filter=FAULT.pattern, fault_entries=faults,
            relevant_entries=[row for row in rows if re.search(r'\bxe\b|0000:05:00.0|drm|guc', str(row.get('MESSAGE', '')), re.I)],
            dump_present=dump_present, total_rows=len(rows))
        save()
        assert not faults and not dump_present, 'fresh GPU fault gate'

    def health(label):
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, health_command['argv'], gpu=True)
        assert 'PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words' in stdout.splitlines()
        libraries = [line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('LIBRARY ')]
        assert 1 <= len(libraries) <= 512 and set(libraries) == EXPECTED
        r.setdefault('health_checks', {})[label] = dict(pass_line='PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words',
                                                       mapping_rows=len(libraries), unique_libraries=sorted(set(libraries)))
        save()

    try:
        stdout, _, _ = run('source-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        r['source_revision'] = stdout.strip()
        assert r['source_revision'] == '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        stdout, _, _ = run('embedding-state', ['/usr/bin/systemctl', '--user', 'show', 'llama-server-qwen3embed.service', '-p', 'ActiveState'])
        assert stdout.strip() == 'ActiveState=inactive'
        stdout, _, _ = run('kernel-cursor', ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '-n', '0', '--show-cursor', '--no-pager'])
        match = re.search(r'-- cursor: (\S+)', stdout)
        assert match
        r['kernel_cursor'] = match.group(1)
        r['health_binary_sha256'] = m.sha(Path(health_command['argv'][0]))
        kernel('kernel-before')
        health('health-before')
        kernel('kernel-after-prehealth')
        for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'):
            binary = W / 'build' / mode / 'phase_cache_vmm_test'
            assert m.sha(binary) == build[mode]['vmm_fixture_sha256']
            stdout, stderr, command = run('vmm-' + mode, [str(binary), '--small-layer-bulk'], gpu=True, allowed=(0, 77))
            assert command['exit_code'] == 0, 'Unavailable real VMM is not PASS'
            assert 'PASS small actual owned Host-USM bulk all512 canary/layout/accounting (no model)' in stdout.splitlines()
            assert 'FAIL ' not in stdout + stderr and 'SKIP ' not in stdout + stderr
            assert EXPECTED <= set(r['actual_library_maps']['vmm-' + mode]['paths'])
            r.setdefault('cases', {})[mode] = dict(passed=True, complete=True, exit_code=0,
                binary_sha256=m.sha(binary), maximum_fixture_device_bytes=1 << 20,
                all512_experts_verified=True, seven_aligned_widths_verified=True,
                reserved_physical_accounting_unchanged=True, declined_layout_per_expert_fallback_verified=True)
            kernel('kernel-after-' + mode)
            health('health-after-' + mode)
            kernel('kernel-posthealth-' + mode)
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in lint['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(path) == sha for path, sha in r['provider_hashes'].items())
        assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip() == r['boot_id']
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, actual_small_bulk_qualified=True, actual_full_physical_lease_qualified=False, model_qualified=False)
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
        if owner.active is None and r.get('kernel_cursor'):
            try:
                kernel('kernel-final-after-failure')
            except BaseException as fault_error:
                r['final_fault_error'] = repr(fault_error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'gpu_executed', 'actual_small_bulk_qualified')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
